description: This file implements a custom stream buffer class 'SharedFDStreambuf' and stream classes 'SharedFDOstream' and 'SharedFDIstream' for handling shared file descriptors in the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It provides buffered read and write operations over shared file descriptors.

classes.name: SharedFDStreambuf
classes.description: A custom stream buffer for reading from and writing to a shared file descriptor with internal buffering.

classes.name: SharedFDOstream
classes.description: An output stream class that uses SharedFDStreambuf for writing data to a shared file descriptor.

classes.name: SharedFDIstream
classes.description: An input stream class that uses SharedFDStreambuf for reading data from a shared file descriptor.

methods.name: underflow
methods.description: Refills the buffer when it is exhausted, reading data from the shared file descriptor.

methods.name: xsgetn
methods.description: Reads a specified number of characters from the buffer into a destination buffer.

methods.name: overflow
methods.description: Writes a character to the shared file descriptor, flushing the buffer.

methods.name: xsputn
methods.description: Writes a sequence of characters to the shared file descriptor.

methods.name: pbackfail
methods.description: Handles put-back area failures, allowing one character to be pushed back into the buffer.

methods.name: SharedFDOstream
methods.description: Constructor initializing an output stream with a shared file descriptor.

methods.name: SharedFDIstream
methods.description: Constructor initializing an input stream with a shared file descriptor.
